headline: Fly to Fairy Meadows, at the foot of the 'Killer Mountain'
facts: Nanga Parbat: 8,126 metres, the world's ninth-highest mountain
Fairy Meadows sits at about 3,300 metres
Reached by jeep from Raikot Bridge, then a 2-3 hour hike
